resources.string: Count the links traced as a whole number from 0 to 4. Share traced (percent) = 100 × that count / 4. Links remaining = 4 minus that count. The plot rounds the input to the nearest whole link.

Sensory fibers from the clitoral glans run in the dorsal clitoral nerve, a branch of the pudendal nerve. This schematic follows one side: glans → dorsal clitoral nerve → pudendal nerve → sacral spinal nerve → spinal cord via a dorsal root. The four arrows count equally; they group parts of the pathway and do not mark synapses. The percentage is progress through the schematic, not distance, time, or sensitivity.
